title: 6835--BULK OXYGEN and TANK RENTAL
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.246-NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 6 (36C246)
detail_text: The Department of Veterans Affairs Network Contracting Office 6, 100 Emancipation Drive, Hampton, VA 23667, intends to award a sole source Firm-Fixed-Price purchase order to MATHESON TRI-GAS, INC., 3 MOUNTAINVIEW RD STE 3, Warren, NJ 02048 for the Asheville VA Medical Center, 1100 Tunnel Rd. , Asheville, NC 28805 for Bulk Oxygen and Tank Rental for the period of 4/6/2026-10/6/2026 with a competitive procurement as a follow-on. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this requirement is 325120 with a small business size standard of 1,200 Employees. THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTATIONS. Responsible sources may identify their interest and capability to meet this requirement by submitting such information by 12:00 PM., EST, on Monday, 13 April 2026. All inquiries and submittals must be sent via email to Natasha Leahy, Contracting Officer, at natasha.leahy@va.gov. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted.
